statements.status_notes: Standalone jackson-core copies in the Spring Boot fat jar are forced to 2.21.4 and tools.jackson 3.1.4 during the image build. Remaining findings are shaded inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar (2.21.2 / tools.jackson 3.1.2) or parquet-jackson-1.17.1.jar (2.21.3). Those classes are unreachable by Gradle resolutionStrategy; Hazelcast 5.7.0 is the latest 5.x release and parquet-jackson 1.17.1 is the latest bundle embedding jackson 2.21.x.

These findings come from Jackson copies shaded inside com.hazelcast:hazelcast 5.7.0. Unshaded jackson-core is forced to 2.21.5 via ext.jacksonVersion during the image build. Hazelcast 5.7.0 is the latest published Hazelcast release; no available 5.x release bundles the fixed Jackson versions, and shaded classes cannot be replaced with a Gradle dependency override. Tracking Hazelcast for a release that embeds fixed Jackson.
